issues.issue: Has a breach of natural justice been established so as to allow the claim to be reopened after it was declared abandoned?
issues.applicant_position: Counsel says the Basis of Claim form was submitted on time on October 13, 2019, supported by a fax copy.
issues.result_text: No breach of natural justice principles has been established; the forms reached the Board only on December 13.

issues.issue: Did the applicant comply with Rule 62(2) by forwarding the application to reopen to the Minister?
issues.applicant_position: Provided a fax receipt dated December 12, 2019 addressed to the Ministère de la sécurité publique, 26 pages.
issues.result_text: Applicant did not comply with Rule 62(2); this may be seen as an attempt to mislead the Tribunal.
